summary: Tested the signed-document lifecycle features on backend and frontend. IMPORTANT: the sandbox tenant c942fe2a-8919-48ea-9dc6-a2bf0e51b6ed and the user test@sandbox.it do NOT exist in this preview DB (login returns 'Credenziali non valide' and GET /super-admin/agenzie/c942... returns 404). I used the TEST tenant 3b056fe9 (TEST_RESET_TENANT) for the firma_provider writes and admin@assicura.it with TEST_-prefixed models (all cleaned up) for the templates. Backend: 14 of 16 pytest checks pass. firma_provider is listed, read, PATCHed to openapi/yousign and persists; it is case-normalised; an invalid value returns 400; non-superadmin gets 403; the workspace id is kept. document_target_card persists on create, list, get and PUT, and can be cleared to null. The public YouSign webhook returns 200 + ignored for an unknown id, an empty body, the alt key signature_request_id and non-dict data; an array body returns 422. Frontend: the Super Admin 'Provider di firma' select (ea-firma-provider) has the options YouSign and eSignature OpenAPI, saving shows the 'Agenzia aggiornata' toast, and the value persists after reopening. In Librerie the 'Card Documentale di Riferimento' dropdown (modello-target-card) renders with the grouped options. Create (201, quietanza), edit preload, change to privacy_firmata (PUT 200) and reset to 'Nessuna' (null) all work with no JS errors.

minor.issue: tipo='documento' (wording from the review request) returns HTTP 500. ModelloBody.tipo is a plain str, but TemplateModello.tipo is a Literal (email|whatsapp|sms|word|pdf_*), so the pydantic ValidationError is raised inside the handler. It should be a 422/400: make ModelloBody.tipo use ModelloTipo, or catch ValidationError.

The azienda_config upsert (firma_provider / yousign_workspace_id) runs BEFORE the tenant-existence check. A PATCH on an unknown tid returns 404 but still creates an orphan azienda_config doc (reproduced with a fake id). An orphan already exists for c942fe2a-... Move the tenants lookup/404 check before the upsert.

Legacy firma_provider='namirial' is stored for tenant-principale-schiantarelli and c5ae2d0e (Importazione Axicura), and the API returns it as is. _firma_provider() treats it as yousign by falling through to the else branch. Normalise it (map unknown values to 'yousign') in the list/get responses or with a migration.

firma_provider is still in _CHIAVI_AZIENDA, and this endpoint writes to raw_db.azienda_config.find_one({}), which is an ARBITRARY tenant's config. Saving the global API keys can therefore overwrite one agency's per-tenant firma_provider. Remove firma_provider from _CHIAVI_AZIENDA now that it is per-agency.
Internal exceptions return 200 {ok:false}, so YouSign will not retry. This is acceptable because the 2-minute poller is the backup, but it is worth noting.

ui_bugs.issue: For a tenant whose stored firma_provider is 'namirial' (Schiantarelli), the select shows 'YouSign'. Saving any other field then silently overwrites the provider to yousign.
The dialog title reads 'Modifica modello' even when creating a new model (modelli-new).

issues: Provider di firma uses a native <select> (like Piano/Stato) rather than the shadcn Select used elsewhere. This is consistent within the modal and only cosmetic.

action_items: Recreate or seed the sandbox agency (tenant c942fe2a-..., test@sandbox.it / Test1234!) in this environment, or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md. It is missing from the preview DB.
Return 422 instead of 500 for an invalid tipo in POST/PUT /api/librerie/modelli (use ModelloTipo in ModelloBody).
In update_agenzia, check that the tenant exists before upserting azienda_config, and delete the orphan azienda_config for c942fe2a-... if the tenant really does not exist.
Remove firma_provider from _CHIAVI_AZIENDA (global chiavi-api PUT writes to an arbitrary tenant's config).
Normalise legacy 'namirial' firma_provider values to yousign/openapi.
critical_code_review_comments: super_admin.update_agenzia: the upsert happens before the 404 check, which creates orphan config docs.
super_admin._CHIAVI_AZIENDA still contains firma_provider, which conflicts with the new per-agency setting (global find_one({}) on a tenant-scoped collection).
modelli.ModelloBody.tipo is a str while TemplateModello.tipo is a Literal, so a bad tipo produces a 500.
documenti_genera.py reads document_target_card correctly (line ~500), but the end-to-end archive of the signed PDF into the card could not be exercised without real provider signing.

success_rate.backend: 88% (14/16; the 2 failures are the minor bugs above)

test_credentials: superadmin@assicura.it / superadmin123! and admin@assicura.it / Admin123! work. test@sandbox.it / Test1234! is INVALID here (the user and tenant c942fe2a do not exist).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_ models were deleted. TEST tenant 3b056fe9 firma_provider was restored to yousign.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The sandbox tenant is missing in this preview DB; use TEST tenant 3b056fe9-9766-4c70-8e13-202eaf964b6f for super-admin writes and admin@assicura.it with TEST_ names for templates. UI selectors: sa-edit-{tid} -> ea-firma-provider (native select), and the save button is the form's submit button. In Librerie: lib-tab-modelli -> modelli-tab-pdf -> modelli-new -> modello-nome, modello-target-card (shadcn Select, options by role=option with emoji labels), modello-save. Edit a model with modello-card-{id}. The webhook is POST /api/esignature/webhook/yousign with no auth.
rca of the issue: 500 on tipo='documento': ModelloBody(tipo:str) passes validation, then TemplateModello(tipo=Literal) raises a pydantic ValidationError inside the handler, which surfaces as an unhandled 500. Orphan config: update_agenzia calls azienda_config.update_one(upsert=True) before tenants.update_one matched_count check.
